dedupe_keys.name: lca algebraic parametric life cycle assessment

description: lca_algebraic is the Mines Paris PSL O.I.E team's Python layer for parametric life-cycle inventories and rapid impact calculations in Brightway. It contains helpers for defining activities, symbolic parameters, Monte Carlo experiments, Sobol sensitivity indices and physical-unit checks. Inputs are inventories, impact methods and parameter assumptions; outputs are impacts and sensitivity results. Geographic and temporal coverage come from the selected inventories, not a fixed dataset. BSD-2-Clause source is free, while background databases have separate terms. A limitation is that Brightway 2.4 and 2.5 require different package versions. Parameter formulas are also incompatible with Activity Browser until values are frozen for a scenario. The package supports environmental comparisons of infrastructure design, energy and material choices. Brightway (platform-brightway-lca) is its underlying catalogue resource. The project was developed for ADEME's INCER-ACV work. No inventory database was accessed or impact calculation run.
